top_choice_rationale: P002 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) honours the quantum spin Hall prediction, the Z2 classification and the first experimental observation: a conceptual framework with a stable, disorder-robust interpretation, confirmed by decisive transport work and fifteen to twenty years of independent follow-up. The three-name allocation is unambiguous for the core (Kane and Mele for theory, Molenkamp for observation) and the citation can be worded to avoid the HgTe proposal, 3D topological insulators and the quantum anomalous Hall effect, which keeps it distinct from the 2016 prize. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang attribution gap is real but disclosed. P001 (lattice clocks) has the cleaner credit and is my fallback, ahead of P003, whose pairing mechanism and disorder sensitivity are not yet settled; any award is ranked above no award.
